description_en: Cancels the maximum available bandwidth setting for an EIP that has been added to an Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
description_zh: 调用CancelCommonBandwidthPackageIpBandwidth接口取消已经加入共享带宽中的EIP的最大可用带宽值的设置
kebab_example: aliyun vpc cancel-common-bandwidth-package-ip-bandwidth --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --bandwidth-package-id cbwp-bp13d0m4e2qv8xxxxxxxx --eip-id eip-2zewysoansu0sxxxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: CancelCommonBandwidthPackageIpBandwidth

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 共享带宽所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
parameters.name: bandwidth_package_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the EIP that has been added to the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
parameters.help_zh: 已经加入到共享带宽的EIP的实例ID
parameters.name: eip_id
